title: Episode About the Sacrifice of Elder Sahibzadas

blocks.text: With only a few shots left, the defenders fired at close range and piled bodies before the walls, while the chaos of Chamkaur grew thicker. (22)

In that moment Sahibzada Jujhar Singh resolved that a son should not remain behind as a silent spectator while his father faced death. Remembering the warrior code, he chose to go out and fight. (23–24)

He cut down opponents wherever he charged, scattering the enemy line and leaving the field so confused that friend and foe were hard to distinguish. After heavy slaughter he attained martyrdom, and the battle moved toward the last sacrifices of the Guru’s elder sons. (25–27)
